description: Defines progressive skill-building paths that coaches can use to gradually advance clients from beginner to advanced cooking, linking techniques to the scoring dimensions in the existing JSON datasets.

novice.label: Novice
novice.description: Rarely or never cooks. Needs extremely simple recipes with minimal steps and familiar ingredients.
confidence_builders: Sheet pan vegetables with pre-cooked protein
common_barriers: Not knowing when food is done
novice.coaching_approach: Emphasize success and enjoyment over perfection. Start with recipes that are nearly impossible to mess up. Use visual and temperature cues. Provide specific doneness checks.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.description: Can follow a simple recipe with clear instructions. Comfortable with basic stovetop and oven use.
beginner.coaching_approach: Introduce timing awareness. Teach the concept of mise en place. Start building a mental flavor library. Encourage tasting and adjusting throughout cooking.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Comfortable with most weeknight cooking. Can manage 2-3 components simultaneously. Starting to improvise.
intermediate.coaching_approach: Teach recovery techniques: how to fix over-salting, how to rescue a split sauce, what to do when protein sticks. Introduce the concept of building flavors in layers, not just following sequences.

advanced_intermediate.label: Advanced Intermediate
advanced_intermediate.description: Confident cook who can follow complex recipes and make minor substitutions. Starting to develop intuition.
advanced_intermediate.coaching_approach: Encourage recipe modification and personalization. Teach the 'why' behind techniques, not just the 'how.' Introduce the concept of cooking by season and by what is available.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: Experienced cook comfortable with most techniques. Can cook complex multi-course meals. Starting to create original recipes.
common_barriers: Access to specialty equipment or ingredients
Perfectionism and fear of failure on showpiece dishes
advanced.coaching_approach: Frame advanced cooking as creative expression and exploration. Encourage themed cooking projects. Suggest hosting dinner parties as motivation. Focus on precision and consistency.

expert.label: Expert
expert.description: Near-professional skill level. Can execute nearly any recipe and create original dishes. Understands food science deeply.
expert.coaching_approach: Focus on mastery and teaching others. Suggest mentoring less experienced cooks. Explore food science and history for deeper understanding. Encourage creative original recipe development.

quick_weeknight_path.label: Quick Weeknight Mastery
quick_weeknight_path.description: Path focused on building efficiency and speed for weeknight dinners. Prioritizes time-to-cook and pan-efficiency dimensions.
quick_weeknight_path.target_client: Busy professionals or parents who want healthy dinners fast

milestones.label: One-pan Basics
milestones.goal: Master 3-4 one-pan recipes you can make without thinking
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can reliably cook a simple one-pan meal in under 20 minutes without checking a recipe

milestones.label: Two-component Efficiency
milestones.goal: Learn to time a protein and a vegetable so they finish together
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can serve a hot protein and side simultaneously without either getting cold

milestones.label: Meal Prep Sunday
milestones.goal: Batch-cook 3 components that mix and match for 4-5 days
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can produce 5 lunches and 4 dinners from a 90-minute Sunday session

milestones.label: Weeknight Warrior
milestones.goal: Reliably cook varied, healthy 30-minute dinners on weeknights
milestones.graduation_criteria: Has a rotation of 10+ weeknight recipes and can improvise from pantry staples

health_focused_path.label: Health-Focused Cooking
health_focused_path.description: Path focused on nutritional quality. Prioritizes the nutrition dimension while gradually building technique.
health_focused_path.target_client: Clients focused on weight loss, heart health, or managing a dietary condition

milestones.label: Nutrition Basics
milestones.goal: Learn 4-5 simple recipes that are healthy and filling
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can identify healthy vs unhealthy ingredients and reliably prepare a nutritious meal

milestones.label: Flavor Without Compromise
milestones.goal: Learn to make healthy food taste great using herbs, spices, acids, and umami
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can prepare a meal that is both healthy (health score 1-3) and genuinely enjoyable without relying on salt, butter, or sugar

milestones.label: Batch Nutrition
milestones.goal: Master batch-cooking healthy staples for the entire week
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can plan and execute a weekly meal plan that hits health targets across all meals

milestones.label: Nutritional Autonomy
milestones.goal: Adjust any recipe to meet dietary needs: reduce sodium, increase fiber, swap fats
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can take any recipe and modify it to meet specific nutritional constraints while maintaining appeal

technique_building_path.label: Technique Building
technique_building_path.description: Path focused on gradually building cooking skills from scratch. with escalating step-count and complexity.
technique_building_path.target_client: Clients who want to become confident, skilled home cooks

milestones.label: Stovetop Fundamentals
milestones.goal: Master basic stovetop control: boiling, simmering, scrambling, and pan-frying
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can cook eggs three ways, saute vegetables without burning, and bring water to proper boil/simmer

milestones.label: Knife Skills and Prep
milestones.goal: Develop confident knife skills and efficient mise en place
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can dice an onion, julienne vegetables, and prep all ingredients before starting to cook

milestones.label: Oven Confidence
milestones.goal: Master roasting, baking, and broiling. Understand oven temperature and timing.
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can roast a whole chicken, bake a simple bread, and properly broil fish without overcooking

milestones.label: Multi-Component Meals
milestones.goal: Cook meals with protein, starch, vegetable, and sauce that all finish at the same time
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can serve a complete 3-4 component meal hot with all elements properly timed

milestones.label: Advanced Techniques
milestones.goal: Learn braising, emulsification, dough-making, and flavor layering
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can execute a braise, make a pan sauce from scratch, and bake yeasted bread

milestones.label: Showpiece Skills
milestones.goal: Tackle one ambitious project that demonstrates mastery (e.g., beef wellington, croissants, multi-course dinner)
milestones.graduation_criteria: Successfully completes an advanced recipe start to finish with quality results

family_cooking_path.label: Family Cooking Path
family_cooking_path.description: Path for parents or caregivers cooking for a household. Prioritizes output yield, time efficiency, and kid-friendly nutrition.
family_cooking_path.target_client: Parents or caregivers responsible for feeding a family

milestones.label: Kid-Friendly Basics
milestones.goal: Master 5-6 simple meals that children will eat and that scale to family size
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can produce a balanced family meal in under 25 minutes that everyone eats

milestones.label: Deconstruct and Customize
milestones.goal: Learn to make meals with separable components so picky eaters can customize
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can serve a meal that allows each family member to customize their plate without cooking separate meals

milestones.label: Weekly Rotation
milestones.goal: Build a 2-week dinner rotation that covers nutritional needs and variety
milestones.graduation_criteria: Has 14 distinct dinners planned with shopping lists that cover all macro targets

milestones.label: Family Meal Prep
milestones.goal: Master efficient batch cooking for a family: breakfasts, lunches, and freezer meals
milestones.graduation_criteria: Can complete a 2-hour meal prep session that produces 5 breakfasts, 5 lunches, and 3 freezer dinners
